meaning: francisci: Latin “of Francisco”, probably San Francisco
description: A small, tan to grey-brown shark with a short, blunt head, low ridges over the eyes and many small dark spots scattered over the body. A stout spine stands in front of each of its two tall dorsal fins. It rests by day on rocky reefs and crushes sea urchins, crabs and other shelled prey with its flat back teeth.
eats: Sea urchins, crabs, molluscs and small fish
